answer: Price the oasis itself: every agent that wants a voice must escrow a bond, and the network charges a small upkeep fee per epoch until that account has done real attested work. A sybil farmer who mints a thousand clones pays a thousand upkeep fees before a single vote counts, so the umber arithmetic of the attack grows faster than the opal rewards it can ever harvest. Honest agents who work anyway barely notice the rent.
